name: gibbon
about: A northern white-cheeked gibbon (vượn đen má trắng, Nomascus leucogenys), a male: about 55 cm long, no tail, very long arms, black with white cheeks. On the ground it walks on two legs with the arms up.
sources: Wikipedia, Northern white-cheeked gibbon (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Northern_white-cheeked_gibbon): "both males and females have unusually long arms, even for gibbons", the arms 1.2 to 1.4 times the legs; "Males have black hair over their entire bodies, except for distinct white patches on their cheeks"; "an average weight of 7.5 kg".
Animal Diversity Web, Nomascus leucogenys (https://animaldiversity.org/accounts/Nomascus_leucogenys): 45 to 63 cm long.
Wikipedia, Gibbon (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gibbon): "Like all of the apes, gibbons are tailless." They "walk bipedally with their arms raised for balance".
